pr_title: Update buying power model interface for better messaging
pr_body:
The `HasSufficientBuyingPowerForOrder` method has been updated to return a result object including the reason the order cannot be executed.

The `SetHoldings` method has also been updated to display a message if `CalculateOrderQuantity` returns zero.

Fixes #1576
pr_comments: Approving and merging under the agreement that we'll come back and collate these error strings into a common place for reuse and consistency purposes.

issue_context.title: GDAX CanSubmitOrder Doesn't Reject Shorts
issue_context.body:
Shorts are not supported with cash modelling on GDAX. We should reject them outright. This is causing SetHoldings("BTCUSD", -1) to hang. 

We need to update  `GDAXBrokerageModel.CanSubmitOrder` to check for shorts -- so the transaction handler will flag the order as invalid and it should exit the wait for market order loop.
comments:
I cannot reproduce a hanging on the `SetHoldings("BTCUSD", -1)` in backtesting mode. Happens that the short order is not executed, and the `SetHoldings("BTCUSD", -1)` is called for every new `OnData` because [`Portfolio.Invested == False`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/5eabec08b52e7606c4a6a2b8dfc14935009917a0/Algorithm.CSharp/BasicTemplateCryptoAlgorithm.cs#L53).

In turn, the short order is never executed because, given the `AccountType.Cash` for the GDAX broker, a short order will never reach the `GDAXBrokerageModel.CanSubmitOrder`. The order size will be zero from the [`CashBuyingPowerModel.GetMaximumOrderQuantityForTargetValue`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/5eabec08b52e7606c4a6a2b8dfc14935009917a0/Common/Securities/CashBuyingPowerModel.cs#L143) method.

So, in principle, the solution is throwing an exception from the `CashBuyingPowerModel.GetMaximumOrderQuantityForTargetValue` method. What do you think?

review_comments: If we don't answer _why_ here we'll have to answer it in support later; please add a _reason_ and _solution_ to each message.
